gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Athletic and stretched wide, Tourney cuts every stroke to one width, while Noto Sans Grantha stands tall in flattened bowls. Lines of it glide along without a single snag.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-hk: Noto Sans HK sets large lowercase forms with brush ends lifted away before each curve closes. Tourney, meanwhile, stretches wire-straight strokes wide across the top of the page.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Strokes of one width and wide tracking give Tourney its bulky, athletic stance. And Noto Sans Kharoshthi lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line, its curves left open.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Tourney stretches its words wide, every stroke cut to a single width and the small letters oversized. Noto Sans Khojki takes over with wide exits and a large eye on every e, letting light through.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-kr: Clean, generous curves in Noto Sans KR meet Tourney, whose single-thread strokes make the heading read like following one line. Big x-height and stubby stems keep the text moving smoothly.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-lao: Tourney builds each glyph from a ribbon of constant width, stretched wide and bulky for a bold athletic look. But Noto Sans Lao does the quieter job, with mouths that stay open and an x-height pushed high.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Noto Sans Lao Looped makes words read as solid blocks, with bowls left unfinished on one side, rather than as skylines. Tourney above it adds wirelike, single-thickness strokes and wide tracking.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Wide and bulky: Tourney frames every counter in same-width strokes. Noto Sans Lepcha brings a lowercase with the stature of cast iron capitals and curves that keep a wide opening.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Approachable Noto Sans Lydian keeps capitals barely taller than lowercase, its openings wide as a sprung paper clip. And beneath the Tourney heading, with its wire-like monoline skeleton, text moves along without a hitch.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Noto Sans Malayalam builds a texture where the middle zone dominates the line, its s opening generously between bends. Noto Sans Malayalam holds that dense middle beside Tourney, whose r, n and m keep arches matching their stems.
